title: Video by neromma
description:
STOP Shadow boxing with dumbbells for endurance.

Its actually one of the most ineffective way or building endurance.

Fighting runs mostly on the Alactic and Aerobic energy systems. So chasing that shoulder burn is a waste of effort.

Instead, do this ✅
Hop on the Assault Bike.
8 Sec of MAX effort sprints.
Rest 45 seconds
Repeat that for 10 rounds.

This trains your Alactic Energy system, and that is the one responsible for exploding over and over again in fights 🔥

Start doing this and you'll carry your power deep into the rounds instead of fading after the first combo.

And if you want my entire conditioning blueprint so you can stop gassing out, comment the word "GASTANK" and I will send it to you 🤝📬
